```prolog
% A train is east‑bound iff its first car (car number = 1) is short,
% and either it is not red, or it is red with a roof that is “none” or “solid_roof”.

eastbound(T) :-
    has_car(T,C),
    car_num(C,1),
    car_len(C,short),
    (   car_color(C,red),
        (has_roof(C,none) ; has_roof(C,solid_roof))
    ;   car_color(C,green)
    ;   car_color(C,blue)
    ;   car_color(C,yellow)

    ).
```

```prolog
    has_car(T, C),

    ).
```

```prolog

%   – its 4th car has a railing wall, and
%   – its 5th car has a railing wall, and
%   – either the 1st car also has a railing wall,
%     or the 1st car has a full wall and (it carries passengers
%         or the 2nd car has a full wall).
eastbound(T) :-
    has_car(T,C4), car_num(C4,4), has_wall(C4,railing),
    has_car(T,C5), car_num(C5,5), has_wall(C5,railing),
    (   has_car(T,C1), car_num(C1,1), has_wall(C1,railing)
    ;   has_car(T,C1), car_num(C1,1), has_wall(C1,full),
        (   passenger_num(C1,N), N > 0
        ;   has_car(T,C2), car_num(C2,2), has_wall(C2,full)
        )
    ).
```

```prolog
% East‑bound trains are exactly those that contain a car C such that
%   – C has no windows,
%   – C carries at least five passengers, and
%   – one of the following holds
%        * C is a mixed‑type car with 2 wheels;
%        * C is a passenger car with 2 wheels and either
%              – it is long, or
%              – it is short but not white;
%        * C is a passenger car with 3 wheels and its colour is not yellow.
eastbound(T) :-
    has_car(T, C),
    has_window(C, none),
    passenger_num(C, N), N >= 5,
    (   (car_type(C, mixed), has_wheel(C, 2))
    ;   (car_type(C, passenger), has_wheel(C, 2),
        (   car_len(C, long)
        ;   (car_len(C, short), car_color(C, Col), Col \= white)
        ))
    ;   (car_type(C, passenger), has_wheel(C, 3),
        car_color(C, Col), Col \= yellow)
    ).
```
